WEB SOLUTION SYDNEY / WEBSITE REDESIGN

Website redesign for a business that has moved forward

Your services may have changed. Your website may be difficult to update, awkward on a phone or full of information that no longer fits. A redesign is a chance to make it useful again.

Web Solution Sydney helps businesses in Sydney and across Australia improve the structure, content and presentation of their existing websites.

Start with what needs fixing

We look at the current pages, navigation and enquiry process before proposing the new website. If analytics and search data are available, they can help show which pages people use and what should be preserved.

Sometimes a site needs a clearer message and better contact options. Sometimes its structure or platform needs more substantial work. The project scope should follow the problem.

Make the important information easier to find

We can reorganise your services, rewrite unclear sections and give your work examples more useful context. The design should support those improvements with readable text, clear headings and contact options that work well on mobile.

Plan the move carefully

Existing URLs and useful content need attention during a rebuild. Where a page address changes, the launch plan should map it to the appropriate replacement. We also check links and forms so visitors can complete their enquiries.

Questions about redesigning

Can I keep my domain? In most redesign projects, the business can keep its existing domain. Access and the launch process are checked during planning.

Will a redesign automatically bring more traffic? No. Design can improve how a website works for visitors, but search visibility needs its own diagnosis and work. We can include an SEO scope where appropriate.

Can you work with my existing content? Yes. We review what remains accurate and useful, then identify what needs updating or replacing.

A redesign should preserve useful pages

Before replacing an existing website, we identify the pages, downloads and contact routes people may already use. Where a URL must change, we plan a relevant redirect. Important service information should remain accessible after launch, and analytics should be checked so you can compare the new site with the old one.

If the problem is a quiet inbox, read why a website may not get enquiries. It helps separate visibility problems from unclear content or a broken contact process. Ongoing SEO services can be scoped alongside a redesign when attracting relevant search visitors is also a priority.
